Catherine Patry passed away in April 1943, and that year Alfred fell ill, leaving the care of the lighthouse to his son Laurier.
Laurier was officially made head keeper of Cape Anguille Lighthouse in 1945, and his father passed away two years later.
Laurier retired on December 31, 1983, and Henry Reid, who had been serving as an assistant since 1959, was promoted to replace Laurier.
Keeper Reid retired in 1991, and in early 1992 Leonard Patry, son of Laurier and head keeper of the Channel Head Lighthouse at Port aux Basques, was transferred to Cape Anguille

notes_for_editor: Keeper roster rests on Lighthouse Friends (secondary, itself citing Marine annual reports and a 2011 news article); no USLHS data for Canada. Laurier Patry's end date differs: 1982 (federal heritage statement) vs 31 Dec 1983 (Lighthouse Friends); Lighthouse Friends' keeper line says 1984 for Reid and 1991 for Leonard. The Marine annual report table of keepers for 1909 prints 'Alfred Petry' beside Cap Norman in a column-split table; not used. Heritage NL says the station was authorised in 1905 and tower built 1908-1909; the Marine reports show fog alarm construction in 1906. Reports label the station 'Cape Anguille, P.Q.' in 1906. Dale Lomond (current keeper per LF) deliberately left out. Page numbers: 1909 chief engineer's mention cited by scan page 54 (printed number unconfirmed); 1906 p.45 and p.53 taken from OCR page heads.
